title.rendered: Press Release – Sherwood High School Welcomes New Associate Principal

content.rendered:
Sherwood School District is pleased to announce Josh Pratt as the new Associate Principal at Sherwood High School. Mr. Pratt is currently serving as the SHS Dean of Students, and will assume his new role on July 1, 2023, following Caitlin Everett’s departure for her new position as Principal of Banks Middle School.   

“Sherwood is an amazing community that I have felt so lucky to get to be a part of over the last several years,” noted Mr. Pratt. “I am very excited and honored to continue to serve the staff, students, and Bowmen community in this new role. I look forward to continuing to work to make Sherwood High School a great place for every student.”

Josh received his undergraduate degree from Lewis & Clark College in Political Science, and his Masters of Arts in Teaching and administrative licensure from George Fox University. He was a middle school language arts and social studies teacher in Newberg prior to joining the staff at Sherwood High School, where he has taught language arts and social studies, and most recently served as the Dean of Students.

“We are excited to welcome Josh as our new Associate Principal of Sherwood High School,” said Adam Mitchell, Sherwood High School Principal. “Josh has a strong student-centered focus, a dedication to the success of Sherwood High School, and an incredible ability to build relationships with all stakeholders. He will be a strong asset in continuing the exceptional success of Sherwood High School and the Sherwood School District.”
